updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Decouple Policy Tips from Email Notifications
updates.summary: Admins can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications for SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rules, instead of enabling both or neither. This gives compliance teams finer control over user notifications and reduces alert fatigue by allowing selective enablement of each notification type.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Alert Classification Feature
updates.summary: Analysts with appropriate Purview permissions can now classify insider risk alerts as True Positive, Benign (operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons. This replaces existing dismissal workflows and helps organizations better categorize risk signals to improve reporting, tuning, and incident response.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Microsoft Graph API for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides unified access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary), eliminating the need for deprecated Exchange Web Services. This modernization lets admins manage archive retention and lifecycle policies programmatically with a single seamless interface.

updates.title: Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view detailed per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled, remain unlabeled, and were included in simulation snapshots during auto-labeling enforcement. This visibility helps identify labeling progress and data drift for tuning classification policies.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Adaptive Protection Integration
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on dynamic insider risk levels. Users' risk scores automatically trigger retention policy changes, enabling dynamic data preservation aligned with security posture.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Azure PST Import Migration
updates.summary: Admins can now import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service workflow. This modern alternative to network-based PST uploads streamlines mailbox migrations with built-in validation and analysis phases.

updates.title: CVE-2026-97785: Azure AD App Proxy Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure AD Application Proxy allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Admins should apply available security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized access escalation in hybrid identity scenarios.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web versions 3 and 4 contain an elevation of privilege vulnerability that can allow attackers to bypass authentication controls. Organizations using Microsoft Identity Web for custom authentication integrations should update to version 3.16.0 or 4.16.1 respectively.

updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and can apply restrictive actions based on DLP policies. Admins can configure these legacy transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to prevent data exfiltration through file transfer protocols.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Global Secure Access Integration with Network Data Security
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access now integrates with Purview to enforce DLP policies at the network layer, protecting data in browsers, apps, APIs, and AI interactions while blocking risky uploads to untrusted cloud apps. This enables centralized access control and insider risk detection for cloud and AI platform usage.

updates.title: Information Barriers: Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers policy compliance report helps admins identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This visibility enables rapid remediation of compliance drift when information barrier policies are updated.
